title: Silver Anniversary Reel
author: Jim Kitch
problems: Row 1 "mad robins, robins in front (clockwise)" isn't drawn yet.
The progression after row 8 "neighbors allemande right once" doesn't work out: Couples 1 and 2 have not passed each other yet.
Row 2 "circle left 3 places" can't start from where the dancers are: A circle of 4 needs the dancers spaced around a ring.

unparsed.why: No figure pattern matches "mad robin, ladles in front (clockwise)".

choices: A meltdown swing starts with 4 beats of right-shoulder round, then swings.

figures.text: robins roll away partners with a half sashay
robins start a full hey - lefts in center, rights on ends
pass through to an ocean wave & balance - robins by left in the center, partners by right on the sides
